campaign_spec.critical_open_problem: Does repeated distinction-induced admissibility deviation form a self-conditioning vortex of future admissibility organization without separate memory structures?

hypothesis.statement: Admissibility organization becomes a co-generator of future admissibility organization (D_n -> delta_alpha_n -> D_{n+1}).

test_design.description: Evaluate cumulative shift in constraint deviation across successive update cycles under vortex and control configurations.

tests.name: Reset Control
tests.description: Admissibility filter is reset to base at each cycle.

tests.name: Random Control
tests.description: Admissibility updates are randomized at each cycle.

tests.name: Single Cycle Control
tests.description: Distinction evaluation is checked for a single cycle only.

tests.name: Accumulative Vortex
tests.description: Admissibility deviations accumulate systematically across cycles.

vectors.name: Conditioning Bias Check
vectors.attack: Compare distinction distribution bias in valid_accumulative vs reset_topology controls.
vectors.failure_condition: Cumulative distinction bias in accumulative runs is statistically indistinguishable from reset controls.
vectors.implication: Distinction events do not condition future admissibility organization.

maximum_supported_claim.statement: Repeated distinction events condition subsequent admissibility filter states, forming a local self-conditioning vortex.
